description: Download a TherapyPortal document as a file, by portal_document_id from therapyportal_list_documents: a form the client completed (rendered to PDF by the portal) or a file the practice uploaded for review. Saves to disk and returns the path on a local install, or returns the bytes inline (base64) on a hosted runner.

dest.description: Folder to save into (server transport, local install only). Must be inside THERAPYPORTAL_OUTPUT_DIR, or ~/Downloads / ~/Documents when that is unset.

name: therapyportal_download_document
